decisions.title: Keep the core product boundary independent of runtime adapters
decisions.rationale: The core workspace owns domain contracts while runtime adapters own process and I/O concerns.
alternatives: Share runtime state through teaching implementations
reviewWhen: core imports runtime-specific process or filesystem APIs
the workspace introduces a second production runtime boundary

decisions.title: D19: separate single-run execution from workflow authority
decisions.rationale: This V2 registration records the confirmed D19 boundary: Rein owns single-run execution facts, Veriflow owns workflow and overall acceptance, and Web Studio provides environment and observations. The previous registration and its prerequisite hashes remain unchanged. Unresolved delegation, CLI and provider details are not implementation authorization.
decisions.scope: D19 and the RuntimePort candidate; no runtime implementation or historical design-body rewrite
alternatives: Treat local verification as overall acceptance
reviewWhen: RESULT-SPLIT-1 replaces the provisional RuntimePort mapping
D19 unresolved delegation, CLI or Web Studio provider questions are decided
